text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Unicorn Stakes is finally here.<n>Shinko Windy is
attracting a lot of<n>attention because of her previous
incident.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Look! It's the biter everyone's been<n>talking about.
Haha, I'm rooting for<n>you, biter!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Hey, Windy! ♪ Keep your teeth to<n>yourself today!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Don't say that! I wanna see her<n>chomp more
people! That's the<n>whole reason I bought a ticket!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Urgh! Why're they still talking about<n>that?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...At least they're here for me, even if<n>I don't like
the reason.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ahem!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: GWAAAR! It's Shinko Windy, comin'<n>at ya!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Talk about intimidating! She's<n>like a real
thug!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
No wonder she calls herself a wicked<n>villain. Only
bad guys pull cowardly<n>tricks in order to win...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: HUH?! Wh-what did you just say<n>about me?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm an evil villain, sure, but not like<n>that!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I went and apologized to that<n>girl
afterwards! I even promised<n>Trainer I wouldn't do it
again.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I win races fair and square! I'm no<n>cheater!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha! Yeah, right!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrrrrrawr! What's their deal?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
They don't know what "I won't do it<n>again" means
or something?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She sowed these seeds herself, so<n>she has no
choice but to endure the<n>teasing for now.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrr... If they wanna see a bite thatbad, maybe I should give them one.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gah! No, no, no! I promised no more<n>biting at the
racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Which means I can't go biting any of<n>the other
racers either.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I wanna win,<n>how much I'm
ticked, or how itchy<n>my teeth get...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No! I gotta control myself! Control!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'mma vent all this by running.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrrwar! You better all be watching<n>me!
